text: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1134522' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, md.pref_name ASC, cs.canonical_smiles ASC;
